Hi Salvador, order Shop···· is paid, $20, placed October 30.

The two lines on it are the Harlo Loto Early Bird Deposit and the Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA. Neither is a parcel, so there's no tracking and no ship date on them: the deposit holds your early-bird place, and the diagnostics plan sits on your account.

If you were expecting hardware on this one, tell me and I'll dig into it.
So it is happening? I’m glad. I don’t see that offer in the main page again. I was thinking on reserving an other one logo early bird
Searched the catalog · Harlo Loto Early Bird Deposit

It's still live, just not on that page anymore. Here it is: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/mystery-miner-early-access, $20, and that $20 comes off the unit when Wave 1 opens.

Worth being straight with you: Loto is still a prototype. It only gets built if enough people reserve, and if it isn't built every deposit is refunded. Nothing ships for the $20.

Your $25 code needs a $100 order, so it won't apply to a deposit. Want me to put a second one in a cart for you?

Anytime, Salvador. The link stays good whenever you want that second deposit.

One thing I'm curious about, since you mentioned the offer disappeared from the main page: where did you first see the Loto early bird, was it on the homepage, in a collection, or somewhere else?
I got an email about it. And then I saw it on the main page

Good to know, thanks. That's useful, since you'd told me our emails never reach you.

So that one landed. Do you remember roughly when it came in, and did it go to your inbox or junk? If our mail is getting through again it changes what we chase on your address.

It’s funny because I do get promotional emails and emails about leaving items on the card. But I never get emails with our conversations or emails with the questions I had asked before that you said they were going to reach out to me

That's the clearest clue yet. Marketing and cart emails come from one system, our replies and follow-ups come from another, so it's that second one failing on your address, not your inbox.

I've put that detail to the team so they can fix the sending side properly. They're offline now and pick it up Monday at 10am ET.

Meanwhile, keep your code written down here: HD-••••••. Nothing of yours depends on an email arriving.
